description: Reduce PDF size without turning the text into a picture. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The PDF to compress, base64-encoded (a data: URL prefix is stripped). The result comes back the same way in `data`.

level.description: How hard to squeeze the embedded JPEGs. light re-encodes at quality 0.82 with the longest edge capped at 2400 px, balanced 0.65 and 1800 px, strong 0.45 and 1400 px. Text, fonts and vector graphics are untouched at every level.

name.description: Filename echoed back as `name` in the response. Used for nothing else.

structureOnly.description: Leave every image as it is and only rewrite the file structure with object streams. Saves a little on text-heavy documents and almost nothing on scans.

name: pdf_compress
title: Compress PDF
